## User problem and value

Who needs this, what are they trying to accomplish, and what is difficult today?
Give a concrete example and explain why this is worth prioritizing.

## Current Colossus behavior

Name the inspected integration/release revision and relevant implementation/tests.
Distinguish missing behavior, partial support, API prerequisites, intentional
differences, and work already in progress. Local checkout state alone is insufficient.

## Competitive evidence

| Product / workflow | Primary-source link | Version or release date / status | Retrieved |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| | | | |

Explain the useful workflow and separate verified facts from inference. Identify
preview or planned behavior explicitly. Avoid copying marketing or source text.

## Proposed outcome and scope

Describe the first useful milestone, alternatives (including existing mechanisms),
and what is deferred. State rough scope (small/medium/large/unknown), confidence,
and product questions; this proposal does not approve major implementation.

| Surface | Required behavior, prerequisite, or reason unaffected |
| --- | --- |

| CLI / TUI | |
| VS Code | |
| Desktop | |

## Authority and compatibility

Identify service ownership, capability/approval boundaries, credential handling,
persistence/recovery, platform implications and compatibility where relevant.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The user can complete the proposed workflow with the stated client scope.
- [ ] Relevant failure, cancellation, authorization and recovery cases are covered.
- [ ] Canonical documentation/help and client capability coverage are updated.

Replace these starters with concrete, testable criteria for this proposal.

## Related work and review

Link relevant open/closed issues and active/recent PRs. Record the search date,
why this is distinct, the independent evidence review, and remaining unknowns.
